title: The Economy of Verified Capability
offering: A source-bound complete-lock metadata decision packet: adopt for further application qualification, hold a substantiated conflict, or refuse incomplete evidence.
buyer: Maintainer of the existing public Alpha native application; observed internal dependency-assessment need, modeled commercial demand only.
primary_claim: Whether validated graph selection/composition improves complete accepted fresh packets enough to repay its incremental layer relative to an equally evidenced searchable registry and the strong incumbent.

arms.A: Strong native Workbench incumbent, same legitimate cached wheels and independent metadata verification, fixed approved workflow.
arms.B: Searchable output-indexed registry of exactly the same skills, evidence, authority/freshness checks and relationship dossiers; a cached independently validated recipe selects the composition without graph traversal.
arms.C: Same skills and evidence, with explicit typed adjacency traversal selecting dependencies; common admissibility and independent composition verification.
arms.D: Direct conventional pip workflow with identical independent acceptance and report packaging; additional stronger alternative without the native-history requirement.

freshness: 15 unseen pairwise compositions of six archived predecessor substitutions plus three preselected root-requirement stress changes. These are new questions over historical source inputs, correlated rather than 18 independent software ecosystems. No new release, customer order or prospective market sample is claimed. The15 compositions are the primary cohort; three root changes are designed stresses reported separately.
primary_endpoints: paired complete elapsed and CPU seconds C minus B on15 composition missions
paired complete elapsed and CPU seconds C minus A on15 composition missions
false current reuse and refusal/fallback counts
modeled project-inclusive surplus and operating-funded qualifying investments

success_criteria.technical: All originally registered questions retained; exact same acceptance across arms; no unsafe current reuse; compositions require independent combined-workflow evidence.
success_criteria.transfer: Improved accepted useful outcomes or reduced complete cost on registered fresh questions; safety controls and repeated cache confirmations are reported separately.
success_criteria.economic: Positive incremental complete-cost outcome versus strongest suitable alternative, including discovery, rejected work, validation, indexing, proof, identity, upkeep, storage and remaining attention. Unmeasured monetary categories keep actual economic admission unknown.
success_criteria.modeled_second_investment: Existing canonical gate, actual constructed/admitted/used asset identity, operating-generated resources only after obligations and reserve; full incremental cost repayment and positive project-inclusive paired profit.

design.balanced_order: Frozen18 four-arm orders; each arm appears4or5 times per position; all A/B/C/D interleaved.
design.adaptive_repair: None after freeze; all incomplete or failed cases retained. Any correction requires separate registered edition, original outcomes preserved.
design.timing_inference: Descriptive paired finite-cohort values only; no independence claim from combinations, no human-labor conversion, no repeated-run significance mining.
design.economic_calibration: 15 primary composition missions only;3 root stresses reported separately.

authority.attesters: Exact authenticated direct single-label agent.agi.eth identity in bounded fixture; Jobs club role cannot authorize graph admission.
authority.root_writers: Independent operation grant, exact direct agent node, current controller/wrapped holder/full operator or scoped delegate fixture.

controls: unchanged-request cache confirmation, not new job
source/requirement change invalidates previous mission identity
ablations: Same proofs/authority/freshness with graph traversal replaced by the strongest cached registry recipe
authority gate removed, diagnostic unsafe control only
freshness gate removed, diagnostic unsafe control only
relationship compatibility gate removed, diagnostic unsafe control only

candidate_screen.decision: strong control and valid adoption alternative
selected structural hypothesis; explicit traversal may reduce repeated relationship reconstruction or refuse invalid composition earlier
rejected before implementation: spelling does not prove authority; unsuccessful discovery charged, no credentials

limitations: Real local pip and verifier execution with archived public wheels; no installed application qualification.
Fixture identity authority does not authenticate a live ENS controller.
Merkle inclusion authenticates record commitment only, not truth or usefulness.
Research authoring/inference/attention cash cost is unknown; explicit scenarios are assumptions, not bills or empirical bounds.
Existing Jobs contracts, roles, settlement, runtime owners and historical studies unchanged.
